readings._comment: GET /api/readings (decision 0037): the newest meter readings the chain accepted from the Native lane, for the in-browser ML-DSA-87 check on Verify. max: readings listed. pageSize and maxPages: REST transactions per page and the most pages one refresh reads (every Native call into the contract is on those pages, not only readings). cacheSeconds: how long the list is reused; a new reading arrives once a day per system.

funds._comment: deploy/selftest.sh (decision 0040): one warning when this account holds less than warnQor whole QOR. A press costs about 0.2 QOR. deploy/funds.sh keeps its own lower line in config/app.json funding.lowBalanceQor.

selftest._comment: deploy/selftest.sh (decision 0040), run from cron every 6 hours while the demo is judged. failsBeforeAlert: failed runs in a row before one warning. statusTries and statusRetrySeconds: reads of /api/demo/status before it counts as failed (the chain read behind it can blip). balanceToleranceQor: how far the status balance may differ from the chain (it is cached for a few seconds). timeoutSeconds: one HTTP read. verifyTimeoutSeconds: the full public verify.

deploy._comment: deploy/deploy.sh refuses to build or run a new image from freezeAfter on (the entry is judged as submitted). Only when the judges ask for a change: MENTARI_JURI_MINTA='<what they asked>' bash deploy/deploy.sh. --rollback and --status still work.
